Business intelligence services for small businesses in Toronto and the GTA

Data Fort helps independent pharmacies, locally owned retail and e-commerce stores, and beauty and wellness clinics turn everyday business data into clearer decisions. We provide tool-neutral business intelligence services for small businesses across Toronto, North York, Richmond Hill, Thornhill, Vaughan, Newmarket, Markham, Etobicoke, Scarborough, and the Greater Toronto Area.

The work is practical: dashboards, KPI reporting, monthly business insights, customer retention analysis, sales reporting, inventory reporting, refill retention, rebooking and no-show reporting, product performance, and margin visibility. If your data is spread across point-of-sale systems, booking tools, pharmacy systems, online store exports, accounting files, or spreadsheets, Data Fort helps organize the numbers into reporting that owners and staff can actually use.

Why Data Fort

Common reporting problems

Signals that your business is ready for better BI reporting

Small teams often have the right data but not the time or structure to turn it into answers. These are the situations Data Fort is designed to help with.

  • Reports take too long to assemble Numbers live in exports, spreadsheets, booking systems, pharmacy systems, or online store reports.
  • Customer behaviour is hard to see Owners know retention matters, but repeat purchase, refill, rebooking, and churn patterns are not clear.
  • Inventory and margins need sharper visibility Sales totals are visible, but product performance, slow movers, stockouts, and margin trends are not easy to track.

FAQ

Questions small business owners usually ask

What business intelligence services does Data Fort provide?

Data Fort builds small business dashboards, KPI reporting, monthly business insights, customer retention analysis, sales reporting, inventory reporting, and plain-language performance summaries for owners and operators.

Do you work with independent pharmacies, retailers, and clinics?

Yes. Data Fort focuses on independent pharmacies, locally owned retail and e-commerce stores, and beauty and wellness clinics in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.

Do we need to use a specific dashboard or BI tool?

No. The service is tool-neutral. Data Fort starts with the business questions, current data sources, and reporting workflow, then recommends a practical dashboard and reporting setup.

Can you help if our data is spread across systems and spreadsheets?

Yes. Many small businesses have useful data split across point-of-sale systems, booking tools, pharmacy systems, online stores, accounting exports, and spreadsheets. Data Fort helps organize that data into clearer reports and decisions.

Which areas do you serve?

Data Fort serves Toronto and the GTA, including North York, Richmond Hill, Thornhill, Vaughan, Newmarket, Markham, Etobicoke, and Scarborough. Remote support is available when it fits the engagement.
